label: rem:option-e-isospin-test
title: Option E ($c_\lambda$ Kashiwara crystal weight) and the $T = {}^3\mathrm{He}$ isospin invariance
html:
The Option E Kashiwara crystal weight c_\lambda(q) evaluates the principal q-specialisation of the Schur polynomial. It is applied to test whether the canonical \bowtie_K-coupled words preserve the structural isospin invariance.

The mirror isobars ^3\mathrm{H} and ^3\mathrm{He} fail the invariance test under Option E. The weight factor c_\lambda heavily breaks the transpose-partition symmetry required by the Hopf antipode. Only symmetric weights can preserve the structural isospin equality. A properly symmetrised variant is required to correct the non-Markov-trace deviation.
